game_abilities.title_en: Soundblaster records his Combo success, preventing his Combo Meter from being reset.
game_abilities.desc_zh: Soundblaster 记录了他的连击成功，防止他的连击计被重置。

game_abilities.title_en: If Soundblaster is hit by a Special Attack Critical Hit or Ranged Critical Hit, his Combo Meter is immediately reset.
game_abilities.desc_zh: 如果声爆者受到特殊技暴击或远程暴击，他的连击计数器会立即重置。

game_abilities.title_en: Soundblaster’s Ranged Attacks have a {{var_1}} chance to Nullify an Armor or Melee Buff on the opponent. Increase chance by {{var_2}} for each 5 points of Combo Meter.
game_abilities.desc_zh: Soundblaster 的远程攻击有 {{var_1}} 几率无效化对手的装甲或近战增益。 Combo Meter 每 5 点，几率增加 {{var_2}}。

game_abilities.title_zh: Buzzsaw 发射 3 发追踪对手的子弹。
game_abilities.title_en: Buzzsaw fires 3 shots that track the opponent.
game_abilities.desc_zh: Buzzsaw 发射 3 发追踪对手的子弹。
game_abilities.ui_trigger: Buzzsaw 发射 3 发追踪对手的子弹。

game_abilities.title_en: Hitting an Unstoppable enemy causes Stun for {{var_3}}.
game_abilities.desc_zh: 击中不可阻挡的敌人会导致 {{var_3}} 眩晕。

game_abilities.title_en: After ending a Special Attack, if Combo meter is even, Soundblaster gains {{var_4}} Attack Up for {{var_5}}.
game_abilities.desc_zh: 结束特殊技后，如果连击计数器为偶数，Soundblaster 将为 {{var_5}} 获得 {{var_4}} 攻击力提升。

game_abilities.title_en: After ending a Special Attack, if Combo meter is odd, the opponent gets a -{{var_6}} Attack Debuff for {{var_7}}.
game_abilities.desc_zh: 特殊技结束后，如果连击计为奇数，对手将获得 {{var_7}} 的 -{{var_6}} 攻击减益效果。
